title: Identidad y reconocimiento
goal: Read how constitutions across the region stopped treating themselves as culturally uniform -- Colombia's multiethnic definition, the 1990s reform wave, Ecuador's 1998 and 2008 changes, and Bolivia's 2009 Plurinational State.

items: Describe how Colombia's constitution defined the nation.
Explain what wave of constitutional reforms swept the continent in the 1990s.
State which countries transformed their constitutions further, Ecuador (1998, 2008) and Bolivia (2009).
Use en calidad de to name a formal status.
